自带购物袋、餐具真能减塑吗，关键在哪？

Do bringing your own bags and utensils really cut plastic, and what's the catch?

能，但前提是“真的反复用”。一次性的布包或竹筷若只用几次就丢，反而因生产耗能更高而不划算；持续使用才是减塑的关键。
Yes, but only if you actually reuse them. A cloth bag or bamboo fork used a few times then tossed can cost more than plastic; consistent reuse is what cuts waste.

为什么少用一次性吸管和餐具能帮海洋？

Why does skipping single-use straws and cutlery help the ocean?

很多一次性塑料会被风吹进河流、最终漂到海里，被海龟海鸟误当食物。少用它们，就少一些塑料去伤害海洋动物。
Many single-use plastics blow into rivers and end up at sea, where turtles and birds mistake them for food. Using fewer means less plastic harming ocean animals.

为什么自带水杯比买瓶装水更环保？

Why is bringing your own bottle greener than buying bottled water?

少用一个塑料瓶，就少一份石油消耗、制造排放和可能的塑料垃圾；一个耐用的水杯能用上千次，平摊下来既省钱又干净。
One fewer plastic bottle means less oil, less manufacturing emission and less waste; a durable bottle is reused thousands of times, saving money and mess per use.

应对气候危机，“个人行动”和“系统层面变革”分别该放在什么位置？

Where do individual actions vs systemic change belong in tackling the climate crisis?

个人低碳选择有示范与需求侧信号作用，但能源、交通、工业的结构性减排取决于政策、基础设施与碳价等系统杠杆；二者互补，不能只靠个人责任替代制度变革。
Personal low-carbon choices signal demand and set examples, but structural cuts in energy, transport and industry depend on policy, infrastructure and carbon pricing; the two complement, and individual duty must not replace institutional change.
